summary: Tests-only red-phase run for issue #5 (generated OpenAPI Swift client). Wrote vendored-spec invariants (iOS/Tests/ColorMatchingAPITests/OpenAPISpecVendoringTests.swift), stubbed-transport generated-client tests for all six surfaces (iOS/Tests/ColorMatchingAPITests/GeneratedClientTests.swift), and three permanent app-level wire-contract tests (iOS/Tests/ColorMatchingLPSAppTests/APIClientTests.swift). Contract deltas between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the published spec (viamin/color_matching#110, merged as PR #113) are recorded in docs/plans/issue-5-openapi-generated-client-tests.md. No Swift toolchain exists in this container, so swift test could not be executed; implementation (Package.swift wiring, vendored openapi.json, client swap) is deferred to the implementation run per phase rules, and the exit criterion is deferred to macOS CI at that PR head.

acceptance_criteria.description: Add swift-openapi-generator + swift-openapi-runtime to the iOS package; fetch or vendor the OpenAPI document from viamin/color_matching#110

verification.evidence: iOS/Tests/ColorMatchingAPITests/OpenAPISpecVendoringTests.swift is written and asserts the vendored document exists at iOS/Sources/ColorMatchingAPI/openapi.json with all six app-facing operations, clean operationIds, path parameters, bearerAuth, servers [{url: "/"}], required component schemas, and codegen normalizations. It cannot pass (document not vendored) and cannot execute (test target not yet declared in Package.swift; that file is out of scope in this phase). Package dependency wiring is likewise deferred to the implementation run; expected wiring is recorded in docs/plans/issue-5-openapi-generated-client-tests.md.
verification.reason_not_run: Implementation (vendored spec + Package.swift) is deferred to the implementation run by test-phase rules; no Swift toolchain in this container to execute tests.

acceptance_criteria.description: Generate the client for the surfaces the app uses today: sheet manifest + recent sheets, capture session creation, measurement upload, judgment upload, ranked results

verification.evidence: iOS/Tests/ColorMatchingAPITests/GeneratedClientTests.swift covers each surface with a stubbed in-memory ClientTransport: getTestSheetManifest (decode + request shape + 404 mapping), listRecentTestSheets (nullable titles), createCapture (nested metadata/quality encoding, 201 decode), uploadMeasurements (RgbPayload anyOf + pair scores encoding, 200 body decode), uploadJudgments (encoding + 200 body decode), getRankedResults (schema-version envelope decode). Generated-shape assumptions were verified against apple/swift-openapi-generator and swift-openapi-runtime sources and are recorded in the plan doc.
verification.reason_not_run: Generated module ColorMatchingAPI does not exist yet; test target not yet declared; no Swift toolchain in this container.

acceptance_criteria.description: Replace the app's hand-written API models with generated types; keep any purely client-side models as-is

verification.evidence: Behavior pinning for the migration lives in iOS/Tests/ColorMatchingLPSAppTests/APIClientTests.swift: pre-existing tests (create capture, upload measurements, upload judgments) plus three added permanent tests (manifest decode + bearer auth, recent sheets nullable titles, measurement upload accepting the published 200+JSON success body). These compile against the current hand-written client, must remain green after the generated-client swap, and pin the wire contract so the swap is observable only through intentional deltas.
verification.reason_not_run: The model replacement itself is implementation work deferred to the implementation run; the added tests could not be executed here (no Swift toolchain).
